mapper.insert: insert into member (id, pw, name, discnt_time, phone, email, auth, car_num, car_type) values (#{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, 200, #{phone}, #{email}, #{auth}, #{carNum}, #{carType})
mapper.select: select id, pw, name, discnt_time AS discntTime, phone, email, auth, car_num AS carNum,car_type As carType from member where id=#{id}
select id, name, discnt_time, phone, email, auth, car_num, car_type from member where id=#{id}

select car.car_stat AS "car_stat", car.spc_no AS "spc_no", space.floor AS "floor", car.ent_time AS "ent_time", car.discnt_at AS "discnt_at", member.auth AS "auth"
from car
join member on car.id = member.id
left join space on car.spc_no = space.spc_no
where car.id = #{id}
order by car.ent_time desc
limit 1

select ent_time AS "ent_time", ex_time AS "ex_time", cost AS "cost", discnt_at AS "discnt_at" from car where id = #{id} and ex_time is not null order by ex_time desc limit 3 offset (#{pageNum} - 1) * 3
select count(*) from car where id = #{id} and ex_time is not null
mapper.update:
update car
set car_stat = 3, cost = #{cost} where ent_time = ( select ent_time from car where id = #{id} and car_stat in (0, 1) order by ent_time desc limit 1 )

update car
set car_stat = 2, ex_time = NOW() where ent_time = (
select ent_time from car
where id = #{id} and car_stat = 3 order by ent_time desc limit 1 )
update member set name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, car_num = #{carNum}, car_type = #{carType}, discnt_time = #{discntTime} where id = #{id}
update member set id = #{new}, pw = #{new}, auth = 0 where id = #{old}
